title: Reasoning-agent unset-fallback undocumented after pin to DEFAULT_MODEL value
evidence:
# (defaults to DEFAULT_MODEL when unset; pinned to gemini-3.6-flash in terraform)
 COMPLIANCE_REPAIR_MODEL=gemini-3.6-flash
...
+# All reasoning agents on gemini-3.6-flash (cost optimization: 3.6 Flash
+# benchmarks higher than 3.1 Pro on intelligence, price, and speed).
+CONSISTENCY_CHECKER_MODEL=gemini-3.6-flash
detail: Reasoning agents now equal DEFAULT_MODEL, yet only COMPLIANCE_REPAIR documents its unset fallback. A deployer who unsets the reasoning vars cannot tell from .env.example whether they fall back to DEFAULT_MODEL or to a pro model.
recommended_fix: Add a "defaults to DEFAULT_MODEL when unset" note (or state the real fallback) to the reasoning-agent block so unset behavior is explicit.

title: Cost-optimization rationale rests on an uncited benchmark claim
evidence:
+# All reasoning agents on gemini-3.6-flash (cost optimization: 3.6 Flash
+# benchmarks higher than 3.1 Pro on intelligence, price, and speed).
detail: The comment asserts 3.6 Flash beats 3.1 Pro on intelligence, price, and speed with no source. If the intelligence claim is false, reasoning quality on the checker, compliance judge, and final reviewer regresses.
recommended_fix: Cite the benchmark source or drop the intelligence claim, retaining only the verifiable cost reduction, so the rationale is auditable.
